title: C15: tilt-cap zero-rate ticket and the scribe log-zoom bound (refs #361)
body:
## Result and scope

Refs #361

- Claim comment URL and session: https://github.com/hairer/humanise-yang-mills/issues/361#issuecomment-6869963191, session `ADB991-claude-20261114-ce9e`.
- Unit IDs or other outputs: YM-000026 (C15). New `manuscript/existence/trace-clock-cap.tex` (`\input` before `trace-small-means` in `manuscript/existence.tex`); citation-only edits in `trace-scribe-producer.tex` and `trace-small-means.tex`; new `blueprint/units/YM-000026/trace-clock-cap-evidence.md`.
- Human contributors and agent assistance: Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.

New section `sec:ex-lattice-trace-clock-cap` with complete proofs of:
- `def:ex-lattice-tiltcap`: `tiltcap(j) = M_j^{log log hat-beta_j} = exp((log log hat-beta_j)^3)`, where `M_j = exp((log log hat-beta_j)^2)` is the clock monitor (source `YM.Trace.Terrace.tilt_cap`, `Station.mag`, `Perch.y`, `YM.Calendar.monitor`).
- `lem:ex-lattice-trace-tiltcap-ticket`: `1 <= tiltcap(j) <= exp((log hat-beta_j)^3)` once `log hat-beta_j >= 1`, and every fixed power `tiltcap^p` has a ticket of rate 0 (source `titles`, `Ticket.pows`). This was listed as an outstanding input in `trace-small-means.tex`.
- The chart receipt `1 <= b_i <= tiltcap(j_i)` (`eq:ex-lattice-clock-cap-receipt`) from the gallery's exponent window `5 < c_i <= log log hat-beta_{j_i}`, `b_i = M_{j_i}^{c_i}` (source `TimberSky.high`, `b_zoom`, `tiltP`).
- `lem:ex-lattice-trace-log-zoom`: from that receipt on a tail and `j_i -> infinity`, eventually `0 <= log b_i <= (log log hat-beta_{j_i})^3 <= (log hat-beta_{j_i})^48`, and `log b_i / hat-beta_{j_i} -> 0` (as used in `YM.Trace.Over.zoom_BQ`). This is the third clause of `eq:ex-lattice-scribe-clock-inputs`, i.e. finding F4 of #357 (part-B ledger edge E-clock, third clause).

Not addressed (still inputs): the two ratio limits of the scribe clock inputs (source `gamut`, `Barry`), and the summit ticket `hat-beta_{summit(j)} <= 2 hat-beta_j` (`bond`, `stickK`). Uncertain: the manuscript's gallery calls the upper exponent "the permitted angular bound"; its value `log log hat-beta_j` is read from `TimberSky.high` and should be confirmed by the reviewer.

## Evidence

- Pinned source revision: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`; base `codex/existence-monograph` @ `97f806c7`.
- Commands actually run and results:

  - `latexmk -pdf -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error -outdir=<scratch> existence.tex` (from `manuscript/`): exit 0, 1024 pages, no undefined or multiply defined references; pp. 934–935 (new section) and the edited scribe and small-means paragraphs inspected in the rendered PDF.
- Checks not performed and why: no Lean command was run (Mathlib sources are blocked in this sandbox); the source correspondence in the evidence note is textual. `unit.json` was not edited: the coordinator should add `trace-clock-cap.tex` to YM-000026's `manuscript` list.
- Dependency/interface changes and affected units: YM-000026 fingerprint changes (two chapter files edited, one added). No statement of an existing result changes; two outstanding-input sentences now cite the new lemmas.
